representative_papers.title: Out-of-distribution Generalized Generative AI
representative_papers.problem: Generative AI models fail under out-of-distribution shifts in deployment environments
representative_papers.approach: Generalizable post-training techniques for OOD adaptation with unified multi-modal frameworks
representative_papers.contribution: Tutorial on OOD generalization for MLLMs and diffusion models across understanding and generation

representative_papers.title: AHBid: An Adaptable Hierarchical Bidding Framework for Cross-Channel Advertising
representative_papers.problem: Multi-channel bid optimization lacks flexibility adapting to dynamics while capturing historical temporal dependencies.
representative_papers.approach: Hierarchical framework integrating diffusion model planning with constraint enforcement and trajectory refinement.
representative_papers.contribution: AHBid enables adaptive budget allocation across advertising channels via generative planning and real-time control.

representative_papers.title: Lang2Plan: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent System for Building Layout Planning
representative_papers.problem: NL-guided layout planning requires strict input quality, lacks interactive refinement and immersive visualization
representative_papers.approach: Multi-agent LLM decomposition with web-based 3D editor and ControlNet-guided diffusion rendering
representative_papers.contribution: Lang2Plan enables robust layout generation from imperfect input with interactive 3D adjustment

representative_papers.title: AWMA-MoE: Attention-Guided Watermark Adapter with MoE for Latent Diffusion Models
representative_papers.problem: Image watermarking introduces quality degradation; existing methods prioritize robustness over generation quality
representative_papers.approach: Attention-guided adapter with spatially varying watermark strengths; mixture-of-experts for quality improvement
representative_papers.contribution: Reduces image distortion while maintaining watermark robustness; balances post-hoc and in-generation methods

representative_papers.title: RaDAR: Relation-aware Diffusion-Asymmetric Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
representative_papers.problem: Graph contrastive learning for recommendations distorted by random edge perturbations
representative_papers.approach: Dual augmentation: graph generative model and relation-aware denoising with diffusion
representative_papers.contribution: Asymmetric contrastive learning outperforms baselines under noisy and sparse conditions

representative_papers.title: Graph Diffusion Evolution Model for Multi-Conditional Molecular Generation
representative_papers.problem: Multi-condition molecular generation misses joint distribution of conditions during generation
representative_papers.approach: Chain-like Markov evolution process gradually adjusting molecular structure with two-stage training
representative_papers.contribution: Improved molecular property control and condition adherence on polymer and small molecule datasets

representative_papers.title: STG-DGR: Fraud Detection on Streaming Transaction Graphs with Diffusion-based Generative Replay
representative_papers.problem: Graph continual learning on streaming transactions faces catastrophic forgetting of fraud patterns; storage constraints limit replay capacity.
representative_papers.approach: Diffusion-based generative replay generates synthetic STG samples via hierarchical denoising; CSP and DSG handle heterogeneity and dependencies.
representative_papers.contribution: STG-DGR retains learned fraud patterns without storing real samples; effective on four streaming fraud datasets.

representative_papers.title: DynaFLUX: Implicit Dynamics-Preserving Reinforcement Learning for Topology-Free Influence Maximization
representative_papers.problem: Influence maximization fails without network topology due to hidden, noisy or privacy-protected links
representative_papers.approach: End-to-end generative framework learning latent dynamics from time series with RL seed selection policy
representative_papers.contribution: DynaFLUX identifies influential spreaders using self-attention pointer and Monte Carlo diffusion rewards

representative_papers.title: GSDiffRec: Enhancing Personalized Sequential Recommendation via Diffusion Augmentation and Guidance Optimization
representative_papers.problem: Sequential recommendation faces sample drift in diffusion models; limited adaptability to noisy data
representative_papers.approach: Geodesic Diffusion Module with manifold constraints; Semantic-Targeted Guidance with shaped attention
representative_papers.contribution: GSDiffRec improves generative sequential recommendation via geodesic walks and enhanced transformer guidance

representative_papers.title: From Agnostic to Specific: Latent Preference Diffusion for Multi-Behavior Sequential Recommendation
representative_papers.problem: Multi-behavior recommendations ignore latent user preferences and suffer from low-entropy behaviors to high-entropy items asymmetry.
representative_papers.approach: Generative diffusion model from agnostic to behavior-specific latent preferences via multimodal autoencoders and RoPE.
representative_papers.contribution: FatsMB framework learns diverse, accurate recommendations on multi-behavior sequences.

representative_papers.title: Communication-efficient Federated Graph Classification via Generative Diffusion Modeling
representative_papers.problem: Federated GNNs face high communication costs and non-IID data across decentralized clients.
representative_papers.approach: Generative diffusion models on each client capture local graph distributions, shared with server, then generate synthetic graphs.
representative_papers.contribution: CeFGC reduces communication to three rounds via generative models, handling non-IID data and proving constant-round complexity.

representative_papers.title: AbFlow: End-to-end Paratope-Centric Antibody Design by Interaction Enhanced Flow Matching
representative_papers.problem: Antibody design lacks generative frameworks for full-atom structures that exploit antigen-specific geometric information for local binding interfaces.
representative_papers.approach: Use flow-matching with equivariant surface encoders to end-to-end design antibodies, leveraging antigen interaction data to refine CDR-H3 and global structure.
representative_papers.contribution: AbFlow generates high-quality antibodies with improved binding affinity by incorporating antigen surface geometry into diffusion-based design.

representative_papers.title: Conflict-Aware RAG: Multi-Stage Learning with Conflict Signals for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: RAG systems fail when integrating conflicting web-sourced information, leading to unreliable responses
representative_papers.approach: Multi-stage optimization using conflict signal from generative probabilities with SFT, DPO, and reranking
representative_papers.contribution: Conflict-Aware RAG robustly handles knowledge conflicts via preference optimization

representative_papers.title: Conditional Information Extraction with Diffusion Model on Fact-Condition Star Graph
representative_papers.problem: Conditional information extraction overlooks hierarchical dependencies and requires exploring all mention combinations
representative_papers.approach: Diffusion model on fact-condition star graph with deterministic in-order matching strategy
representative_papers.contribution: Improved conditional quintuple extraction via hierarchical graph structure and denoising

representative_papers.title: Facilitating Generative Retrieval with Logical Denoising for Interpretable Conversational Search
representative_papers.problem: Noisy context and poor interpretability in conversational search systems
representative_papers.approach: LLM-based logic-enhanced retrieval with curriculum learning and policy optimization
representative_papers.contribution: LogiCGR improves robustness and interpretability of conversational search through logical denoising

representative_papers.title: OFA-MAS: One-for-All Multi-Agent System Topology Design based on Mixture-of-Experts Graph Generative Models
representative_papers.problem: Current MAS design is task-specific; poor generalization to unseen domains.
representative_papers.approach: Universal one-for-all model using Task-Aware Graph State Encoder and Mixture-of-Experts.
representative_papers.contribution: Single model generates adaptive collaboration graphs for any task via MoE-driven topology prediction.

representative_papers.title: Large Language Models-Enhanced Semantic Diffusion for User-Centric Recommendation
representative_papers.problem: Knowledge graphs lack user-side structural information due to scarcity and improper granularity for recommendations
representative_papers.approach: LLMs infer user interests; diffusion models generate contrastive views with semantic transitions
representative_papers.contribution: SEDIRec integrates user-side and item-side information via LLM-diffusion for sparse user recommendations

representative_papers.title: Multi-view Hierarchical Graph Contrastive Learning based on Asynchronous Asymmetric Structure
representative_papers.problem: Contrastive learning lacks feature diversity, multi-level semantics, and balance between tolerance and consistency
representative_papers.approach: Multi-view hierarchical graph contrastive learning with diffusion matrix and asynchronous asymmetric structure
representative_papers.contribution: Three-level contrastive loss framework for node, subgraph, global graph classification

representative_papers.title: FedDiG: Frequency-Guided Diffusion Diversity for Generalizable Federated Time Series Classification
representative_papers.problem: Federated time-series classification struggles with source heterogeneity and OOD patterns
representative_papers.approach: Frequency-guided diffusion for diversity generation across clients with cross-frequency sampling
representative_papers.contribution: FedDiG outperforms baselines by synthesizing diverse spectral patterns for improved generalization

representative_papers.title: Conditional Diffusion Guided Knowledge Transfer for Multi-Domain Knowledge Graph Completion
representative_papers.problem: Multi-domain knowledge graph completion loses domain-specific information when enforcing consistency constraints
representative_papers.approach: Generation-based paradigm using conditional diffusion models guided by support knowledge graphs
representative_papers.contribution: Generates domain-general embeddings while preserving domain-specific information across KGs

representative_papers.title: Many Hands Make Light Work: Group-based Information Diffusion Prediction over Long-Context Cascades
representative_papers.problem: Individual-level diffusion prediction is computationally expensive and truncates long cascade histories
representative_papers.approach: Group-based prediction framework with task-regularized information bottleneck and inter-group attention
representative_papers.contribution: Reduces complexity from quadratic to linear enabling modeling of cascades exceeding 10,000 users

representative_papers.title: Anatomy of Generative Scam Campaigns in Online Advertising Ecosystems
representative_papers.problem: AI-enabled scam campaigns resist moderation through scale, rotation, and cloaking strategies
representative_papers.approach: Campaign-level analysis of production templates, variants, auxiliary masking content
representative_papers.contribution: Empirical characterization shows scams prioritize scale and resilience over fidelity

representative_papers.title: DiSCoQR: Diffusion-Driven Semantic Compression for Robust Image Steganography in Standard QR Codes

representative_papers.contribution: DiSCoQR achieves 400:1 compression while maintaining semantic equivalence and QR functionality

representative_papers.title: AdaQE-CG: Adaptive Query Expansion for Web-Scale Generative AI Model and Data Card Generation
representative_papers.problem: Automated GAI model and data card generation faces static templates, info scarcity, and no benchmarks
representative_papers.approach: Adaptive query expansion with context-aware extraction and cross-card knowledge transfer
representative_papers.contribution: MetaGAI-Bench benchmark and AdaQE-CG framework for transparent AI system documentation

representative_papers.title: DHOW-MiLLA: Joint Workshop on Diffusion of Harmful Content on Online Web and Countering Misinformation in the Age of LLMs and Agents
representative_papers.problem: Harmful content analysis fragmented across platforms, languages, topics; limited cross-platform counter-measure study.
representative_papers.approach: Workshop unifying research on harmful content diffusion across platforms, languages, and content types.
representative_papers.contribution: Brings together misinformation, hate speech, cyberbullying research under one framework with LLM/agent focus.

representative_papers.contribution: Research roadmap for FGVC addressing robustness, explainability, data efficiency, and real-world deployment

representative_papers.title: Generative Archetype-Grounded Item Representations for Sequential Recommendation
representative_papers.problem: Item representations ignore target audiences and gap between semantics and user behavior
representative_papers.approach: LLM-inferred archetype representations with behavioral calibration objective
representative_papers.contribution: Generative archetype-grounded representations improving sequential recommendation quality

representative_papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory Recovery with State Propagation Diffusion for Urban Mobility
representative_papers.problem: Sparse GPS trajectories with low sampling rates limit location-based service quality

representative_papers.contribution: GAM framework balances business objectives and constraint satisfaction for e-commerce auto-marketing

representative_papers.problem: Graph generation often fails to preserve task-critical rationale substructures

representative_papers.approach: MAF-GAN generates text-image with detection awareness via projection head, generator, discriminator

representative_papers.problem: Semantic IDs for generative recommendation lack contextual awareness and efficient quantization
